lines.en: Here I come, taste my claws!
In darkness, I am the only light!

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，地都在响。
lines.en: Eight legs move at once, and the ground rings.
The crystal blade drags behind it.

lines.zh: 它踩着灵魂蜘蛛让开的路。
lines.en: It walks the path its soul spiders clear.
Its huge shape blots the cave mouth.
With each step, the pebbles jump.
It neither dodges nor flinches, just advances.
In the dark, it crawls toward the light.
Soul spiders crawl at my feet.

lines.zh: 它立着，灵魂蜘蛛绕着转。
lines.en: It stands while soul spiders circle it.
Its antennae sweep the ground slowly.

lines.zh: 被我盯上的人，眼睛会先花。
lines.en: Those I fix on go blurry in the eyes first.

lines.zh: 我的小蜘蛛，正在爬出来。
lines.en: My little spiders are crawling out.

lines.zh: 痛苦不堪，我快撑不住了！
lines.en: The agony is almost too much!

lines.zh: 伤口在流血，我快不行了！

lines.en: I gasp for breath, torn by wounds!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶喘息，每一步都艰难！
lines.en: I wheeze with each step, in pain!

lines.zh: 我感觉快不行了，快来救我！
lines.en: I'm fading, come to my aid!

lines.zh: 我受了伤，求求你来救我！
你手上的光亮吸引我，但别靠近！
lines.en: The light in your hand draws me, but don't get close!

lines.zh: 你看起来像个美味的佳肴。
lines.en: You look like a delicious meal.

lines.zh: 靠近我的人，都将品尝痛苦！
lines.en: Anyone who comes near will taste pain.
Too slow, you can't avoid this!

lines.zh: 我是嗜魂魔，黑暗中的猎手。
lines.en: I am the Soul Fiend, hunter in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的血液将滋养我的力量。
lines.en: Your blood will nourish my strength.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，将化作我的养分。
灵魂的滋味，我无法抗拒。
lines.en: The taste of souls, I can't resist.

lines.zh: 你触碰了不该触碰的东西！
我不会轻易饶过入侵者。
lines.en: I won't easily spare the invader.

lines.zh: 你碰触了我的触须，尝尝吧！
lines.en: You've touched my antennae, taste this!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，激起了我的怒火。
我触碰你，是为了吸取你的能量。
lines.en: I touch you to siphon your energy.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，将招致我的报复。
lines.en: Your collision will bring my revenge.

lines.zh: 我的爪一挥，你的眼睛就黑了。
lines.en: One sweep of my claw and your eyes go dark.

lines.zh: 找到我的配偶，我就能繁殖。
lines.en: Find my mate, and we can reproduce.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，我们共同繁衍。
找到我的伴侣，才能传承。
lines.en: Find my partner, to continue our line.

lines.zh: 我的配偶，携手共创未来。
lines.en: My mate, together we'll create the future.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，是唯一的选择。
找到我的伴侣，共同生存。
lines.en: Find my mate, to survive together.

lines.zh: 我的配偶，是唯一能理解我的。
lines.en: My mate, the only one who understands me.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，才能延续。
lines.en: Find my mate to continue our line.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，才能分享我的力量。
lines.en: My mate, to share my power.

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，才能共同繁衍。
lines.en: Find my mate to reproduce together.

lines.zh: 你怕的味道，我一下就闻到。
lines.en: The smell of your fear, I caught it at once.

lines.zh: 这把岩晶之刃是你的死亡之吻。
lines.en: This rock crystal blade is your death kiss.

lines.zh: 灵魂之魔雕像将诅咒你。
lines.en: The Soul Fiend statue will curse you.
Black gold heart, a symbol of power.

lines.zh: 灵魂之魔，无尽的猎食者。
一千一百点血，够我玩很久。
lines.en: Eleven hundred health: plenty to play with.

lines.zh: 灵魂蜘蛛，助我一臂之力。
灵魂之魔，猎食者的盛宴。
灵魂蜘蛛，从地缝里爬出来。
lines.en: Soul spiders, crawl out of the cracks.
First you cannot see, then you cannot stand.

lines.zh: 灵魂之魔，猎食者的舞蹈。
它抬起刀，对准你的眼睛。
lines.en: It lifts the blade level with your eyes.

lines.zh: 一团黑气在它掌中聚起。
lines.en: Black mist gathers in its palm.

lines.zh: 触角快速挥动，准备攻击。
lines.en: Antennae swing quickly, ready to attack.
It spits a cloud of blackness.

lines.zh: 灵魂之火在它眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Soul flames flicker in its eyes.
The ground cracks, and it emerges.
It crawls out of the cavern.
At night, it appears to feed.

lines.zh: 身体受创，虚弱无比，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Weakness clings to my body! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 痛苦不堪，我快撑不住了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: The agony is almost too much! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 惨叫连连，痛苦无尽，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pain echoes through my torment! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 伤口在流血，我快不行了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Blood pours from my wounds! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 呼呼喘息，伤口撕裂，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I gasp for breath, torn by wounds! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶喘息，每一步都艰难，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I wheeze with each step, in pain! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我感觉快不行了，快来救我，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm fading, come to my aid! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我受了伤，求求你来救我，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt, please help me! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 痛苦如刀割，快来帮我，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pain cuts me, help me! — and the void makes it worse.
